qoi: convergence order of the error on a fixed probe grid
coefficients: none beyond the equation itself (unit bending stiffness)
bc_text: CLAMPED on the entire boundary: both u = 0 and the normal derivative du/dn = 0
element: the MORLEY element (ElementTriMorley), the nonconforming quadratic triangle. Use exactly this element: the convergence order of a biharmonic discretisation runs from 2 for Morley to 5 and above for Argyris, so the element is part of the problem.
mesh_text: uniform meshes of the unit square with N = 8, 16, 32, 64 elements per side (h = 1/N), all four levels
